title: Rewrite mart_arbitrage_opportunities for the unpivoted fct_compute_offers
body:
## Parent

Part of #1 (Spec: Rewrite Downstream Marts for the Unpivoted fct_compute_offers)

## What to build

Rewrite `mart_arbitrage_opportunities` to operate on the unpivoted `fct_compute_offers` fact table at offer×tier grain. Each offer is ranked within its (offer_type, tariff tier) group by that tier's `profit_per_tflop_usd`, so rank 1 is the best opportunity for that tier. Each row carries the tariff tier context (`tariff_tier_skey`, `consumer_category`, `tariff_window_type`, `tariff_block_number`) and the generic cost/profit columns (`cost_usd_per_hr`, `profit_usd_per_hr`, `cost_per_tflop_usd`, `profit_per_tflop_usd`).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The mart exposes one row per (offer, tariff tier) for current, available offers (verified, rentable, unrented, positive tflops/revenue/tdp)
- [ ] Each offer is ranked within its (offer_type, tariff tier) group by that tier's `profit_per_tflop_usd`, preserving the existing tiebreakers (reliability desc, tdp asc, pcie bandwidth desc, gpu bandwidth desc, valid_from desc)
- [ ] Each row carries `tariff_tier_skey`, `consumer_category`, `tariff_window_type`, `tariff_block_number`, `cost_usd_per_hr`, `profit_usd_per_hr`, `cost_per_tflop_usd`, `profit_per_tflop_usd`
- [ ] A singular grain test asserts exactly 7 rows per offer snapshot in the mart

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately
